treaty_name: Convention between the Government of the Republic of Austria and the Government of the Kingdom of Bahrain with respect to Taxes on Income and on Capital (2009)
eif_quote: Ratifikationsurkunde wurde gemäß Art. 27 Abs. 1 des Abkommens am 30. November 2010 ausgetauscht; das Abkommen tritt daher gemäß seinem Art. 27 Abs. 2 am 1. Februar 2011 in Kraft.
source_title: BGBl. III Nr. 14/2011, Anlage: English text of AT-BH Convention (RIS)

rates.quote: Dividends paid by a company which is a resident of a Contracting State to a resident of the other Contracting State may only be taxed in that other State.

Income from debt-claims arising in a Contracting State and paid to a resident of the other Contracting State shall be taxable only in that other State if such resident is the beneficial owner of the income from debt-claims.
Royalties arising in a Contracting State and beneficially owned by a resident of the other Contracting State shall be taxable only in that other State.

ppt.quote: Austria does not list the Bahrain treaty as a Covered Tax Agreement (treaty-map: 'Bahrain lists the AT treaty under MLI but Austria does not -> not covered'); the convention itself contains no principal purpose test.

notes: valid_from per Art. 27(2): provisions effective for fiscal years beginning after 31 Dec of the year of exchange of ratification instruments (30 Nov 2010) -> 2011-01-01 (BMF list: 'Anwendbar ab 2011'). Article 11 is titled 'Income from debt-claims'. No source-State taxation on dividends, interest or royalties. MLI not in effect for this pair (AT does not list BH).
